parent.r52_result: Both original seeds: OOD regret zero and 32/32 flips but salience ablation=0, raw allpair control regret=0; frozen DEV NO_GO. Full G4 both platforms PASS, 9856/9856 decision parity, G5 and G7 PASS.

hypothesis.main: A gradient-trained weight on cross-intervention repeatability can distinguish persistent selected action-dependent causal response from distractors with LARGER mean measured action contrast and high public tags but inconsistent response over repeated independent selected interventions.
hypothesis.mechanism: For every public source, 3 independent repetitions of both actually selected action0 and selected action1 effects are observed. The signed action-contrast mean and its across-repetition variance are fixed transparent observable statistics. Train scalar eligibility salience from zero via factual selected-return regret along with two context role slopes, no generator hidden indices.
hypothesis.negative_expected: Public-tag top2, simple top2 by observed mean-contrast magnitude and ungated raw mean-attention can be fooled by action-variant high-tag distractors. Test with same exact FIT information/draws/updates.
hypothesis.strong_positive_control: Hand-coded top2 by public |mean selected action contrast|/(sqrt(within-source variance)+0.02) with trainable role slopes; if matches/equals learned, this is NOT general event discovery.
hypothesis.falsification: Frozen DEV NO_GO if source reference has any error, main fails any frozen threshold or learned repeatability term ablation adds no regret, or no strict gain over trained raw all-source mean contrast. No post-score threshold/source adjustment.
hypothesis.not_proven: A trained weight on a supplied fixed variance statistic is not spontaneous causal learning, general intelligence, independent external transfer, retention under continual learning, or Hybrid Native benefit.

source.remaining_nuisance: low public tag (0.03 if source%3==0 else 0), across 3 replications action-invariant selected physical effects generated from panel/group/source salt and trigonometric nuisance; never depends on hidden gate.
source.source_placement: 4 distinct candidate source indices from SHA256(panel/salt/group/source) ranking: cue,decoy,spurious1,spurious2. No source identities input to policy.
source.selected_intervention_protocol: Observe action 0 physical effect and action 1 physical effect, in that order, from independent reset to the same public tag state, in each of 3 repeats, with both observed effects in actual record. Does not simulate or reveal unchosen *return* action outcome.
source.physical_selected_effect: action0 delta=+signed_contrast, action1 delta=-signed_contrast; encoded through existing selected _record continuous physical effect channel, effect[4] set zero.
source.mean_parity: For opposite evaluator hidden gates, source action keys exactly identical and all 16-dimensional mean over B effects identical. Causal source individual action contrasts change sign but opposite ± and source cue/decoy cancel. No shortcut from aggregate.
source.actual_fifth: Original selected fifth probe, FIT-only calibration; no CAL/OOD calibration.
source.return_law: Same R52/R51 quartic FIT-CAL and cubic OOD synthetic return evaluator with state 0.61/0.73 and action choice goal squared regret; hidden factors evaluator-only.
source.positive_reference: From selected public source/repetition/action physical effects, compute per-source action contrast and sample variance. Take top 2 public ratios |mean|/(sqrt(variance)+.02), select highest/lower of those two public tags by context, multiply selected fifth measured FIT offset. Require 0 errors FIT/CAL/OOD before model scoring.

methods.optimizer: AdamW context slopes, reliability salience, gain lr 0.02; Native and GRU .001, weight_decay=0, grad norm clip1; exactly matched genuine FIT selected return draws.
methods.main: For each source s: m_s=mean_r((effect_a0-effect_a1)/2); v_s=mean_r((contrast_r-m_s)^2); reliability_s=12*abs(m_s)/(1+20*v_s). Softmax logits slope[public_context]*source_tag + trained_beta*reliability_s; weighted signal sum_s weight_s*m_s; decision via true selected fifth and trained positive gain. Beta starts exactly zero.
methods.raw_control: same m_s and observed public tag to contextual learned slopes, no beta; same information/256 updates/seed.
methods.tag_control: top2 by highest observed public source tags, learned context role slopes.
methods.mean_control: top2 by highest abs of source mean action contrast; learned context role slopes.
methods.fixed_stability: top2 by source observable ratio abs(mean)/(sqrt(variance)+.02), learned context slopes and gain; strong handcoded comparator.
methods.native: main plus existing real R34 Native backbone full selected length via local adapter, backbone-zero ablation; report model params and wallclock; no shared source changes.
methods.gru: GRU sees public tag, measured source signed mean, variance, public context, for all sources; trained on same FIT selected information and steps, capacity unmatched; must verify competence before a science superiority claim.
methods.recording: Each arm/seed all CAL/OOD active and 9 OOD ablation action vectors, loss/heldout checkpoints, productive gradients, params/time, learned beta and context slopes, Native ablation, cross-OS action parity, source reference and source means.

frozen_score.independent_qualification_requirements: Must prospectively beat fully trained fixed public stability top2 heuristic and strongly matched fully converged conventional, show genuine cold retention under real interference and independent environment first-use; Native attribution requires positive backbone ablation and repeatable improvement.
frozen_score.failed_conditions: Preserve exact negative outcome; no retune on spent score sources or recasting a trained feature weight as novel causal cognition.
